questions.question: What is the quantile function associated with a distribution function $F$?
questions.explanation: The quantile function of a CDF $F$ is $Q(u)=\inf\{x\in\mathbb R:F(x)\ge u\}$ for $0<u<1$.
questions.source_support: The definition gives $Q(u)=\inf\{x\in\mathbb R:F(x)\ge u\}$.
